name: approach to the small fetus overview
title: A small fetus: suspected on symphysis-fundus height or a risk factor and confirmed by ultrasound estimated fetal weight, intrauterine growth restriction is worked up for a maternal, fetal or placental cause, then gestational age (under 32, 32 to 37, 37 weeks or more) with the Doppler, fluid and non-stress test decides whether to deliver or monitor; each column gives clues, numbered investigations and the action in order

root.title: A small fetus: is it GROWTH-RESTRICTED, and is it time to DELIVER?
lines: suspect: symphysis-fundus height (SFH) more than 2–3 cm behind the weeks (after 20 weeks), or a risk factor
confirm ONLY by ultrasound: estimated fetal weight (EFW) < 10th percentile = small for gestational age (SGA) · < 3rd = real risk of a bad outcome
intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) is a PROCESS: it can sit above the 10th percentile

groups.title: 1 · Find the CAUSE
lines: history first, then tests for the cause it points to

groups.title: 2 · Deliver or wait? GESTATION decides
lines: fetal well-being: umbilical artery (UA) Doppler · amniotic fluid volume · non-stress test (NST)
